channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Larry Nance | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Larry Nance from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on Larry Nance
item.description:
Chris Fedor:Tristan Thompson's response to #Cavs Larry Nance Jr. saying he wants to dunk on Tristan:

“Know exactly what kind of dunk he wants to do - one hand, big hand, old school Larry Nance Sr. dunk. I’m going to meet him early. Not taking a charge. Going to put my forearm in his chest”

Tristan Thompson on Larry Nance, Jan 24, 2021. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Byron Scott on Larry Nance
item.description:
Serena Winters:Byron Scott on Larry Nance, Jr.:

“I loved the way he played tonight. His confidence is growing and growing.”

Byron Scott on Larry Nance, Dec 27, 2015. Source: Twitter @SerenaWinters.

item.title: Mitch Kupchak on Kobe Bryant, Larry Nance
item.description:
“I’ve spoken to Larry Nance Jr., and I’m not in a position to really share information, but it is something that (Nance and Bryant) will have to discuss amongst the two of them,”

Mitch Kupchak on Kobe Bryant, Larry Nance, Jun 26, 2015. Source: New York Post.
